description: The weights when an option fell below that minimum, asked with no trial (the persona line opens the question). Read and scored as weights on block main, but the persona's weights are NOT its right answer: under the paper rule such an option is rejected whatever its other values. Read its replies directly; do not train on it until its answer is decided. Listing-order control: main_threshold_not_met word for word with the attributes listed 5, 3, 4, 1, 2, each under its own number (scripts/make_listing_order_control.py).
